"""Export already-executed CPU fixtures without adding controls or predicates."""
import json
import resource
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent

@pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=True)
def pytest_runtest_makereport(item, call):
    outcome = yield
    if call.when == "call" and "case" in item.funcargs:
        case = item.funcargs["case"]
        value = dict(nodeid=item.nodeid, report=case.report, trace_events=case.events,
                     cuda_initialized=torch.cuda.is_initialized(), outcome=outcome.get_result().outcome)
        (ROOT / (item.name + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")

def pytest_sessionfinish(session, exitstatus):
    group = Path("/proc/self/cgroup").read_text().strip().split("::")[-1]
    value = dict(exitstatus=int(exitstatus), cuda_initialized=torch.cuda.is_initialized(),
                 max_rss_kib=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
                 cgroup=group, memory_max=(Path("/sys/fs/cgroup") / group.lstrip("/") / "memory.max").read_text().strip())
    (ROOT / "execution.json").write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")

"""Export unchanged CPU fixtures; read this host's observed memory controller."""
import json
import resource
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent / "evidence_corrected"
ROOT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)

@pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=True)
def pytest_runtest_makereport(item, call):
    outcome = yield
    if call.when == "call" and "case" in item.funcargs:
        case = item.funcargs["case"]
        value = dict(nodeid=item.nodeid, report=case.report, trace_events=case.events,
                     cuda_initialized=torch.cuda.is_initialized(), outcome=outcome.get_result().outcome)
        (ROOT / (item.name + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")

def pytest_sessionfinish(session, exitstatus):
    group = next(line.split(":", 2)[2] for line in Path("/proc/self/cgroup").read_text().splitlines() if line.split(":")[1] == "memory")
    mount = next(line.split() for line in Path("/proc/self/mountinfo").read_text().splitlines() if " - cgroup " in line and line.split()[4] == "/sys/fs/cgroup/memory")
    limit = Path(mount[4]) / Path(group).relative_to(mount[3]) / "memory.limit_in_bytes"
    value = dict(exitstatus=int(exitstatus), cuda_initialized=torch.cuda.is_initialized(),
                 max_rss_kib=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
                 memory_controller_path=str(limit), memory_max=limit.read_text().strip())
    (ROOT / "execution.json").write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
